note.question: What determines the design of sequential procurement strategies that integrate stochastic and strategic information?
note.overview: This paper studies the design of sequential procurement strategies that integrate stochastic and strategic information. The model considers a buyer who repeatedly demands a certain good and is unable to commit to long-term contracts. In each time period, the buyer makes a price offer to a seller who has private, persistent information regarding his or her cost and quality of provision.

models.summary: The main result of this section establishes that access to quality may in fact be detrimental to the buyer and that when the buyer’s belief is sufficiently low, he or she would prefer to forgo the ability to observe quality realizations in subsequent periods.
